title: Harbor Skills Outreach — replication, identification and exact inference
author: ito_author
scope: Nine assigned files only. Original synthetic project, seven learner tasks and complete instructor sections, two substantive extensions, actual-paper transfer dossier and five essential rubric domains. No external empirical replication or certification is claimed.

proof_audit.judgment: Complete finite compliance identity. Binary monotonicity, exclusion, consistency and no interference are separate; E[Z]=1/2 proves finite assignment-contrast unbiasedness. Positive complier mass permits the population ratio only.

Normal equations and independently residualized FWL give all three coefficients. Complete alternative-law sums demonstrate finite ratio and ANCOVA bias; post-minus-baseline algebra and descriptive receipt means agree with actual observed records.

Pair assignment covariance gives the exact variance; the pairwise sample-variance identity proves each arm estimate unbiased for its finite potential-outcome variance. Expected conservatism is explicitly distinguished from a realized upper bound.

Complete fixed-outcome references, ANCOVA refit at every assignment and inclusive tied ranks give a finite size bound. Alternative-law regeneration and prespecified-versus-selected statistics are separate.

Both linear comparison factors yield all crossing points. All open cells, each exact boundary and both tails are checked. Constant and identically zero factors handled. Endpoint merging preserves holes and singleton possibilities.

Inversion coverage is conditional on a true sharp invariance null. Heterogeneous baseline switcher effects falsify every common scalar null. Complement pairing proves minimum p=1/10 and all-real-line inversion at alpha=1/20. Separate common-effect validation establishes actual null size.

For compliers D(z)=z, the direct term and receipt-coefficient reduction cancel in every observable. At fixed z the receipt effect changes by -delta. The inverse mapping delta=4-target proves all [3,5] points attainable within the declared class.

findings.origin: Independent author quadratic oracle; coordinator chose minimal comparison-root partition.
findings.detail: Skip (a,b)=plus/minus(a0,b0) before collecting factor roots, because the squared comparison is identically zero. Removed redundant 22/5 from the baseline root list; baseline now has 18 genuine roots and weak world 7. Manuscript, model, output, README and independent checker agree. All observed/oracle estimates, p-values and accepted sets are unchanged from approved design.
